sections.title: Class 5.1.1 and 5.1.2 substances to be secured

items.action: Verify— (a) that the quantity exceeds the threshold specified in Table 6 of Schedule 10 of the Regulations; and (b) that the hazardous substance location is secured from access by persons other than those permitted by the PCBU to access the substance
items.records: Evidence to be provided: A record that— (a) identifies the hazardous substance location; and (b) identifies the means by which the substances are secured

sections.title: Likelihood of unintended ignition to be reduced

items.records: Evidence to be provided: A record of the temperature control details To also provide substance decomposition temperature and normal working temperature

items.action: Verify that the area around the class 5 substance is free of incompatible substances, as defined in regulation 12.1
items.records: Evidence to be provided: A record of segregation details If there are 2 or more other substances provide their state and reactivity to confirm compatibility

items.action: Verify the details of separation from ignition sources
items.records: Evidence to be provided: A record of the separation distance or walls Confirm requirements of table 4 Schedule 10 are met.

items.action: Verify separation of particulate matter or gas from ignition sources
items.records: Evidence to be provided: A record of the separation distance or walls

items.action: Verify that there is no ability to ingress electrical equipment
items.records: Evidence to be provided: A record of the separation distance or walls All electrical equipment, level switches, transmitters e.t.c to be IP rated
Evidence to be provided: A note, photograph, or equivalent

sections.title: Control adverse effects of unintended combustion of class 5.1.1 and 5.1.2 substances

items.action: Verify that a controlled zone is established and that persons not personally permitted within the controlled zone are excluded
items.records: Evidence to be provided: Site plan to show a record of the controlled zone

items.action: Verify that the separation requirements comply with the requirements of regulation 12.9(1)(b)(i) and (c) or 12.9(1)(b)(ii) and (c)
items.records: Evidence to be provided: A record of the means by which the separation is established State type and fire resistance of wall Pictures CCC to be attached if applicable If applicable check requirements of table 3 in Schedule 10 are met

items.action: Verify that regulations 12.9(1)(d), (e), (f), and (if a class 5.1.1 or 5.1.2 substance is manufactured or used) 12.10 are met any area where particulate matter or vapour from a substance in class 5.1.1 or a gas in class 5.1.2A is likely to form (including any ventilation outlet or aperture) is separated from any ignition source to the degree provided in paragraph (c); and arrangements are in place so that— (i) every person entering the location is free of any incompatible material; and (ii) direct contact by any person at the location with a class 5.1.1 or 5.1.2 substance is prevented; and (iii) accumulation of a class 5.1.1 or 5.1.2 substance on personal protective equipment inside the location is prevented, unless— (A) the personal protective equipment complies with regulation 12.6 or 12.11; and (B) any material that has accumulated is collected and removed from the location immediately; and (C) the requirements of regulation 12.7(2) and (4) are met; and (iv) the accumulation of incompatible substances at the location is prevented; and
items.records: Evidence to be provided: A record of the means of compliance

items.action: Verify— (a) the separation of the interior of a proximate building that is a place of regular habitation and not dedicated to the use or manufacture of the hazardous substance; and (b) the separation of any place where a person may be legally present in the controlled zone
items.records: Evidence to be provided: A record of the means of separation

items.action: Verify that any fixed structure or equipment within the location is constructed of compatible material and is not an ignition source
items.records: Evidence to be provided: A record of material and construction details

items.action: Review the hazardous substances and the nature of the activities and verify the PPE is suitable
items.records: Evidence to be provided: A record that conveys— (a) the availability of the PPE; and (b) the nature of the PPE; and (c) the compatibility of the PPE with the substance; and (d) that the substance does not accumulate on the PPE; and (e) that the PPE does not cause the substance to combust A record that confirms— (a) that the PPE material cannot be degraded in the specified time; and (b) the suitability of the PPE for the operating temperatures; and (c) that the instructions are accessible; and (d) that the instructions are readily understandable

items.action: Unless the hazardous substance location has only 65-70% aqueous nitric acid, verify whether combustion is intended or contact with incompatible substances or ignition sources, or exposure to greater temperature than the limit, is anticipated
items.records: Evidence to be provided: A record of whether— (a) combustion is intended; and (b) contact or exposure is intended or anticipated

items.action: Verify that the worker uses PPE at any time— (a) a class 5.1.1 or 5.1.2 substance comes into contact with an ignition source or an incompatible substance or material or may be exposed to a greater temperature than the limit set in regulation 12.5(5); and (b) that it is reasonable to expect that such contact or exposure might accidently occur
items.records: Evidence to be provided: A record that refers to— (a) the availability and nature of the PPE; and (b) evidence that the PPE cannot be degraded; and (c) the maintenance documentation; and (d) the operating procedure; and (e) the accessibility of the documentation

items.action: Verify the PPE— (a) is designed, constructed, and operated so as to prevent the substance making direct contact with the wearer or user; and (b) meets the requirements of regulation 12.6(4), (5), and (6)
items.records: Evidence to be provided: A record of— (a) the matters referred to in item three above; and (b) fit tests

sections.title: Arrangements to prevent contact with and accumulation of class 5.1.1 and 5.1.2 substances and incompatible material

items.action: Verify that there are compliant PPE and handling procedures
items.records: Evidence to be provided: A record of the following: (a) the documented procedure, a copy of the header and contents of the documented procedure, or a unique reference to identify the documented procedure: (b) confirmation that the procedural requirementsof regulation 12.9(1)(e) are complied with: (c) confirmation that the documented procedure is being implemented at the location

sections.title: Locations where class 5.1.1 and 5.1.2 substances are manufactured or used

items.action: Verify that, if class 5.1.1 or 5.1.2 substances are manufactured or used, there are documented procedures to ensure that every person leaving the location is free of any class 5.1.1 or 5.1.2 substance
